criteria.reason: The keypad row renders Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done now uses a flex share instead of the previous full width.
Copy Last and Next have a 48px minimum height, but Done has no 44px minimum and its padding may leave it below 44px.
The handler changes the parent value, but NumericKeypad’s local display state is not updated, so the copied value will not appear in the field.
Next updates the keypad field and label to reps, but its local display state is not synchronized with the reps value.
The button styles use design tokens for colors and border radius.
The flex action row and flexible button widths support a narrow mobile layout.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 292 client tests passing.
A new test checks that Copy Last invokes its callback, but does not verify that the previous set’s value is copied.
